description: Phase 1 Foundation Refactor — extract server.js concerns into src/ modules, slim entry point to under 80 lines, add record_snapshots audit table

userStories.title: Extract encryption and version-check helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want AES-256-GCM helpers and version utilities in dedicated service files so they can be imported without pulling in the entire server.
acceptanceCriteria: src/services/encryption.js exports encrypt, decrypt, and all AES-256-GCM helpers currently in server.js
src/services/versionCheck.js exports normalizeVersion, isVersionNewer, getVersionStatus
server.js imports these functions from the new files; duplicate definitions removed from server.js
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extract database layer with singleton db instance
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all SQLite initialisation in src/db/ with a singleton db export so the database layer is isolated from route logic and no module opens its own connection.
acceptanceCriteria: src/db/index.js opens the SQLite database once and exports the db instance as a singleton
src/db/schema.js exports initSchema(db) that runs PRAGMA setup, creates tables, and calls the migration runner
src/db/migrations.js exports the MIGRATIONS array
src/db/statements.js exports buildStatements(db) returning all prepared statement objects
server.js requires src/db/index.js for the db instance, calls initSchema(db) and buildStatements(db); inline db-init code removed from server.js
No module opens its own database connection — all use the singleton from src/db/index.js
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Singleton pattern chosen: src/db/index.js exports the db instance. Modules require it directly rather than accepting db as a parameter at call time.

userStories.title: Extract auth middleware and rate limiter
userStories.description: As a developer, I want middleware in src/middleware/ so route files can import only what they need.
acceptanceCriteria: src/middleware/auth.js exports requireAuth, requireAdmin, requirePermission, requireSelfOrAdmin, checkTableAccess
src/middleware/rateLimit.js exports the login rate-limiter middleware
server.js imports and mounts these; inline middleware definitions removed from server.js
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Factory pattern: createAuthMiddleware({ getUserById, sanitizeUser }) returns all middleware functions. Rate limiter extracted as standalone export.

userStories.title: Extract field registry and shared helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want field-registry constants and utility helpers in dedicated top-level src/ files so every route module can import them without circular dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: src/fieldRegistry.js exports FIELD_REGISTRY, INVOICE_SLOTS, RECEIPT_SLOTS, and buildFieldPatch helpers
src/helpers.js exports sanitizeForSqlite, parseJsonSafely, expandDataRecord, and all other shared utility functions
src/fieldRegistry.js and src/helpers.js do not import from any route or service file
server.js imports from both new files; inline definitions removed from server.js
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: fieldRegistry.js imports parseJsonSafely from helpers.js (no circular deps). helpers.js also exports boolFromRow, defaultPermissionsForRole, sanitizeUser, sanitizeConnection.

userStories.title: Extract auto-flag service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want auto-flag evaluation logic in its own service file so it can be imported by route handlers and the sync engine independently.
acceptanceCriteria: src/services/autoFlag.js exports _evalCondition, _evalRuleConditions, applyAutoFlagRulesToRecord
server.js imports from the new file; inline auto-flag code removed from server.js
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pure functions — no dependencies on db, stmts, or other modules. Exported as named ESM exports.

userStories.title: Extract auth and user routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want auth and user API routes in src/routes/auth.js so the route file is self-contained and mountable as an Express router.
acceptanceCriteria: src/routes/auth.js exports an Express router containing /api/login, /api/logout, /api/me, and all /api/users handlers
server.js mounts the router with app.use(authRouter); inline route definitions removed from server.js
All auth and user routes return identical HTTP status codes and response-body shapes as before
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Factory pattern: createAuthRouter({ db, stmts, getUserById, requireAuth, requireAdmin, requireSelfOrAdmin, loginLimiter }). Routes use /api/auth/* and /api/users/* paths. Login-logs also included.

userStories.title: Extract data-record routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want data-record and custom-field API routes in src/routes/records.js.
acceptanceCriteria: src/routes/records.js exports an Express router containing /api/datarecord, /api/apply-auto-flags, and /api/custom-fields handlers
server.js mounts the router; inline route definitions removed from server.js
All data-record routes return identical HTTP status codes and response-body shapes as before
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Factory pattern: createRecordsRouter({ db, stmts, requireAuth, requireAdmin, requirePermission, checkTableAccess }). Includes custom-fields CRUD, record history, test-rule, auto-flag apply/clear/export/import, and dynamic CRUD /:table routes. Schema cache (allowedTables, getTableColumns) moved into records module.

userStories.title: Extract connection and sync routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want connection and sync API routes in src/routes/connections.js.
acceptanceCriteria: src/routes/connections.js exports an Express router containing /api/connections and /api/sync handlers
server.js mounts the router; inline route definitions removed from server.js
All connection and sync routes return identical HTTP status codes and response-body shapes as before
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Factory pattern: createConnectionsRouter({ db, requireAuth, requirePermission, runConnectionImport, isShuttingDown }). Routes: /api/test-connection, /api/test-query, /api/import/:connectionId. shuttingDown passed as closure getter.

userStories.title: Extract sync engine service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want runConnectionImport and sync-lock helpers in src/services/syncEngine.js so the sync logic is isolated from the HTTP layer.
acceptanceCriteria: src/services/syncEngine.js exports runConnectionImport, acquireSyncLock, releaseSyncLock, and activeSyncs
src/routes/connections.js imports runConnectionImport from src/services/syncEngine.js
server.js no longer contains sync-engine logic
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Module-level exports pattern: syncEngine.js imports db singleton directly and builds its own stmts. runConnectionImport accepts optional { isShuttingDown } second arg. connections.js imports runConnectionImport directly from syncEngine.

userStories.title: Extract HUB_MODE routes and ETL
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all HUB_MODE-specific routes and ETL logic isolated so non-hub deployments are unaffected and the hub surface area is easy to find.
acceptanceCriteria: src/routes/hub.js exports an Express router with all /api/hub/* handlers
src/services/hubEtl.js exports all hub-mode sync/ETL functions used by hub routes
server.js conditionally mounts the hub router only when process.env.HUB_MODE === 'true'
Non-hub deployments are unaffected: hub router not mounted, no hub tables created when HUB_MODE is not 'true'
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Hub ETL (initHubTables, initHubSiteRegistry, syncAllSites, runHubBackupPull, HUB_SITES) in src/services/hubEtl.js. Hub routes (createHubRouter, createNonHubFallbackRouter) in src/routes/hub.js. Both use db singleton and buildStatements internally. server.js conditionally mounts hub router and starts sync timers only when HUB_MODE=true.

userStories.title: Extract reporting, backup, and system routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the remaining route groups in dedicated files to complete the route extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: src/routes/reporting.js exports a router with /api/kpis, /api/reports, /api/customer-balances handlers
src/routes/backup.js exports a router with /api/backup, /api/restore handlers
src/routes/system.js exports a router with /api/version, /api/health handlers
server.js mounts all three routers; inline route definitions removed
All reporting, backup, and system routes return identical HTTP status codes and response-body shapes as before
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reporting router: createReportingRouter({ requireAuth }) — owns /api/kpis, /api/top-balances, /api/inventory, /api/reporting/* and requireReportingToken middleware. Backup router: createBackupRouter() — owns /api/backup/status, /api/backup/download, imports db+dbPath directly. System router: createSystemRouter({ requireAuth, requireAdmin }) — owns /api/app-info, /api/app-version-status, /api/app-update-trigger, and auto-update background check.

userStories.title: Add record_snapshots table and append-only snapshot inserts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want an immutable history of every synced record so we can audit what data looked like at any point in time.
acceptanceCriteria: src/db/migrations.js contains a migration that creates table record_snapshots (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, connection_id TEXT, customer_number TEXT, snapshot_data TEXT, synced_at TEXT)
No UPDATE or DELETE statements target the record_snapshots table anywhere in the codebase

src/services/syncEngine.js inserts one row into record_snapshots after each successful record upsert in runConnectionImport; snapshot_data is the full JSON of the upserted record; synced_at is an ISO-8601 timestamp
Snapshot insert failure does not abort the sync (error is logged and sync continues)
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Migration v9 creates record_snapshots table. Snapshot inserts happen inside runWriteRows transaction in syncEngine.js after each upsert — wrapped in try/catch so failures don't abort sync. Uses SELECT * to capture full record state post-upsert.

userStories.title: Slim server.js to thin entry point
userStories.description: As a developer, I want server.js to contain only imports, middleware mounting, route mounting, and the app.listen call so the file is easy to audit at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: server.js contains no business logic, no inline route handlers, no SQL, no crypto
server.js is under 80 lines
All middleware is imported and applied in order: body-parser, rate limiter, session/cookie, auth
All routers are mounted in the correct order
HUB_MODE router is conditionally mounted with if (process.env.HUB_MODE === 'true')
node --check server.js passes
npm run build passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Business logic extracted to src/startup.js (validateSessionSecret, migrateUnencryptedPasswords, recoverAbandonedSyncs, ensureSeedUsers, createGetUserById) and src/scheduler.js (isShuttingDown, startSchedulers, startHubSchedulers, setServer, gracefulShutdown). server.js is now 79 lines — imports, middleware, router mounting, and startup only.

userStories.title: Smoke tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a fast automated smoke-test that confirms the refactored app starts correctly and responds to a health check, so regressions are caught immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: node --check passes for every file under src/ and for server.js
npm run build exits with code 0
Running the server and calling GET /api/health returns HTTP 200
scripts/smoke-test.sh (or equivalent npm script) automates the above three checks and exits non-zero on any failure
The smoke-test script is documented in README.md or inline comments
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added /api/health endpoint to system router. scripts/smoke-test.sh automates: node --check on all backend files, npm run build, and server health check (GET /api/health). Script documented with inline comments.
